issue.title: Finish full-system integrity audit on current main
issue.body:
Ports the validated integrity work from the old #66 audit onto the current post-#79 main without regressing later PRICE_PROBE/history/browser changes.

Key points:
- durable cross-bot negotiation ownership before FIRST_OFFER
- safe release/reopen semantics before submit; fail-closed after confirmed/ambiguous submit
- bot_command deletion cascades
- per-step read/unread follow-up delays through DB/backend/frontend/Playwright
- ACTION_REQUIRED no longer consumes automated future-step capacity
- hidden production per-run negotiation throttles removed unless explicitly configured
- targeting regressions and Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra coverage
- old audit migrations renumbered to V33/V34 because current main already owns V30-V32
- PostgreSQL migration smoke test added to CI
- keeps the newer main FilterActions implementation/tests instead of overwriting them with the older audit copy

This PR is intended to be merged immediately once all CI jobs are green; the obsolete #66 will then be closed.
